## Summary

The 2026-05-01 [[stripe|Stripe]] Terminal guide covers the custom screen shown when a reader is ready to accept payments. Set it per reader type in the Dashboard or Configuration API. A location-specific screen overrides the account default, and locations without one inherit it. The 2026-11-07 capture supplies Dashboard and API variant links. The implementation guidance below comes from May.

## Key Details

**Dashboard** — Select the location and its configuration, edit or override the **Splash screen** row for the exact reader type, upload the image, and save and apply the change. Configure each reader type separately.

**Image requirements** — Use JPG or PNG below 2 MB and crop to the exact reader resolution. Where GIF is supported, use a file below 4 MB. GIFs scale automatically. If an under-limit GIF fails to upload, the guide suggests halving the frame count and repeating as needed.

**Reader resolutions**:

| Reader | Resolution | GIF |
| --- | --- | --- |
| S700/S710 | 1080×1920 | ✓ |
| WisePOS E | 720×1280 | ✓ |
| Verifone P400 | 320×480 | – |
| WisePad 3 | 320×240 | – (PNG only, automatically converted to black and white and slightly repositioned) |

**Splash-screen update timing** — The May guide says the screen updates on SDK connection for mobile readers and within 10 minutes for smart readers.

**Configuration API**

1. Upload the image through the Files API with `purpose: 'terminal_reader_splashscreen'`.
2. Create or update a Configuration with the returned file ID as `splashscreen` under the matching device key (`stripe_s700`, `stripe_s710`, `bbpos_wisepos_e`, `bbpos_wisepad3`, `verifone_p400`). Stripe provisions the account default configuration.

terminal-fleet-splash-screen.text: Customize the default splash screen for your readers.
Locations without a custom splash screen inherit the account default splash screen.
You can’t upload or apply a single splash screen across every reader type.
the splash screen updates when it’s connected to the Stripe Terminal SDK.

terminal-fleet-splash-screen.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/fleet/splash-screen, the revised source-stripe-terminal-splash-screen links the independent 2026-11-07 Dashboard/API index. The index gives the topic and routes without documenting actors, implementation prerequisites or state changes (new raw lines 5-14). The full 2026-05-01 guide describes the ready-to-accept-payments screen. A location-specific value overrides the account default and a location without one inherits it (old raw lines 8-13). Dashboard operators select the location and exact reader type, upload a conforming image, save and apply. A single image cannot be applied across all types. Mobile readers update on SDK connection and smart readers within ten minutes (old raw lines 19-41 and old raw lines 43-55). API integrators first upload through the Files API using terminal_reader_splashscreen, then create or update a Configuration with splashscreen set to the file ID for the selected supported device type. Stripe provisions the account default (old raw lines 61-70 and old raw lines 87-113 and old raw lines 118-133). The revised summary preserves this May scope and records the WisePad 3 PNG-only conversion and repositioning, exact per-model requirements and GIF upload caveat (old raw lines 43-53).
terminal-fleet-splash-screen.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/fleet/splash-screen, the revised source-stripe-terminal-splash-screen uses the 2026-11-07 capture as navigation. It lists the Dashboard and API .md variants (new raw lines 9-14), corresponding to the earlier combined capture's embedded routes (old raw lines 15-19 and old raw lines 57-64). The omitted May body remains the dated behavioral authority. The source preserves per-model resolution, JPG/PNG below 2 MB with exact cropping, GIF below 4 MB with automatic scaling where supported, the possible need to repeatedly reduce frames, and WisePad 3 PNG-only black-and-white conversion and repositioning (old raw lines 25-27 and old raw lines 43-55). The source preserves the mobile SDK connection trigger and smart-reader ten-minute timing in the splash-specific route; the generic configuration timing is a separate scope (old raw line 55). The source includes the Configuration API's file purpose and exact device keys, including Verifone P400, without generalizing to all Verifone models (old raw lines 87-102). The phrase ‘change the passcode’ is a location-selection wording error. The next steps choose the splash screen and reader type, and the alternate route does the same without changing a passcode. See old raw lines 21-29 and old raw lines 31-41. The former summary linked only the behavioral May raw. The revised page preserves it and links the 2026-11-07 navigation raw separately. It adds the source-to-stripe-terminal-hardware-orders link to complement the existing concept-to-source link at wiki/concepts/stripe-terminal-hardware-orders.md:128, and links the parent stripe-terminal fleet route. The provider index and company routes remain relevant.

concept_suggestions.anchor: Locations inherit account defaults unless overridden. Changes propagate within **10 minutes**. Zone-level configurations are in private preview.
concept_suggestions.proposed_markdown: Locations inherit account defaults unless overridden. The general configuration guide describes up to 10 minutes for changes to reach readers. The 2026-05-01 [[source-stripe-terminal-splash-screen|splash-screen guide]] scopes splash updates to SDK connection for mobile readers and up to 10 minutes for smart readers. Zone-level configurations are in private preview.
